summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to expand Medicare coverage to include certain fall prevention items, such as grab bars and non-slip mats, and exempts these items from budget sequestration.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands Medicare coverage to include fall prevention items, which directly increases the scope of public healthcare services. The entire bill is dedicated to this expansion.

By expanding Medicare benefits to cover fall prevention items, the bill enhances a key component of the social safety net, providing additional support for beneficiaries. This is the central purpose of the bill.
